nodes.label: Webs: complete required set for one transition
nodes.description: V2 copy defines Web as the complete set of required Strands; validator behavior is presented as designed, with implementation limits in technical status.

nodes.label: Required proof role / condition
nodes.description: A role names a condition the transition must prove. It is a requirement category, not itself a concrete Strand/proof instance.

nodes.label: Concrete Strand instance
nodes.description: One proof together with its claim, statement, and metadata binding it to a single step. Keep this distinct from the abstract required proof role.

nodes.label: Proof carried by a Strand
nodes.description: A proof checks that a Strand statement holds over its contained values; V2 copy says it does not by itself establish ledger facts.

nodes.label: Statement bound to a Strand
nodes.description: The validator is described as rebuilding statements from transaction context; these are adopted copy statements, not independently verified here.

nodes.label: Consuming contract and validator
nodes.description: The main copy describes the contract naming required items and validator acceptance; the technical section limits current implementation evidence.

nodes.label: Reusable claim specification
nodes.description: Reusable type/specification; reusing it does not reuse a proof for changed state.

nodes.description: Explanatory navigation only. Does not establish that Webs implements the seven ZK layers.
